name: Book Organizer
description: A Views-powered hierarchical overview and bulk book-level operations UI for Drupal core Book content.
project_description: Book Organizer provides a Views-powered administration screen for Drupal core's Book module. It groups every top-level book with its nested pages in a single hierarchy-aware table (a custom Views style plugin, book_hierarchy_table) at /admin/content/book-organized, with the standard Views title/status/language exposed filters and an in-book search box. Books with more than 20 pages lazy-load their children over an AJAX/JSON endpoint. From each book's operations dropbutton you can edit or view pages, jump to core's Order pages outline UI, add a child page, publish or unpublish the whole book (a state-aware toggle), or delete the book and all of its pages. The publish, unpublish and delete operations run through the Batch API for reliability on large books. It adds one restricted permission, 'administer book organizer', which gates the overview and the AJAX route; individual page operations and each batched node still respect standard node access (view/update/delete). The module does not itself reorder pages or change parents—the Order pages link hands off to core's book.admin_edit outline form.
